messages:
Samir: Morning — async check-in. Onboarded llama-3-7b-qt today, ran evals against our NLI + long-doc summarization sets. Quick summary: quality mostly OK but a few regression clusters on long-context summarization.

Priya K: Nice. can you share the failing examples and what changed?

Samir: Yep. Found two main issues: (1) prompt template we applied truncated the context earlier than upstream baseline, (2) quant profile used tinyq which slightly alters tokenization alignment for long sequences. Repro run command: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"llama3-7b-qt","prompt":"<long-doc>","max_tokens":512}' | jq .
```
Outputs and diffs attached in the thread.

Kelsey: Can you paste one failing pair here? easier to scan inline.

Samir: Pasted two examples below (input -> expected summary -> model output). Example1 shows dropped conclusion sentence; Example2 repeats intro sentences. Also noticed KV cache pressure -> +2-5ms median latency for seq_len>2000 on tinyq.

Evan: Is this blocking rollout to canary?

Samir: Not immediately blocking. We can roll out v1.2.7 safe copy, but prefer to push prompt-template fix + swap quant profile to smallq and re-run smoke evals. I opened PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/456 with proposed changes and initial eval artifacts.

Priya K: I'll review PR later today. Also let's add a quick flag on the eval dashboard to highlight long-doc fails (rouge-l drop >2).

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: model=llama3-7b-qt target=canary-3 scheduled_by=eng-oncall scheduled_at=2026-03-16T18:30:00Z

Kelsey: heads-up — the canary path currently uses the same prompt pipeline. If the prompt fix is needed, hold the canary until PR merges.

Samir: Understood. I'll push a small hotfix to the PR with the prompt template change and updated evals. ETA ~2-3h.

Evan: I'll run a dedicated infra smoke to verify latency/kv behavior once you push. Ping me in thread and I'll kick off the job.

Priya K: Also adding a short onboarding checklist to the PR description: [x] prompt template applied, [x] context-truncation config checked, [ ] quant profile verified, [x] evals long-doc smoke added.

Samir: Checklist updated in PR and added the failing examples. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

Kelsey: thx — please @mention me when PR is green, I'll approve canary hold or proceed.

Evan: ping me for the dedicated run.

Samir: will do. Going offline for deep-diff run now.
